blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce Heu ristic-Guided Fou rier F ine- T uning ( HeuFouFT ), a task-guided framework for selecting trainable frequency coordinates in Fourier fine-tuning. Existing uniform and Gaussian band-pass schemes allocate a limited spectral budget through fixed, task-agnostic rules. HeuFouFT instead searches for coordinates using downstream performance. A coarse intensity map from lightweight block-level probes initializes three metaheuristic optimizers: Genetic Algorithm with Simulated Annealing (GA-SA), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Cuckoo Search (CS). During search, a Random Forest filters each population so that only the top 30% of candidates proceed to proxy fine-tuning. On E2E with GPT-2-Medium, all three variants outperform random-uniform FourierFT, Gaussian band-pass FourierFT, and LoRA across five metrics. PSO further outperforms LoCA, the best-performing baseline, on four metrics while using 37.6% fewer trainable spectral coefficients. Once coordinates are selected, HeuFouFT requires only 15--18% FLOPs of Full FT. These results show that task-guided search allocates limited spectral capacity more effectively than fixed sampling. Our code is publicly available. 2 2 2 Code is available at https://github.com/pierrewang2024-collab/HeuFouFT .
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Heu ristic-Guided Fou rier F ine-T uning(HeuFouFT),这是傅里叶微调中选择可训练频率坐标的任务指导框架. 现有的统一和高斯带-通过计划通过固定的,任务不可知的规则分配有限的光谱预算. HeuFouFT转而使用下游性能搜索坐标. 由轻量级块平面探测器所出粗放的强度图初始化了三种元极化优化器:基因算法与模拟Annaling(GA-SA),粒子Swarm优化(PSO)和Cuckoo搜索(CS). 在搜索过程中,随机森林对每个人群进行过滤,这样只有前30%的考生进行代理微调. 在用GPT-2-Medium的E2E上,所有三种变体都超越了随机-单体FourierFT,高斯乐队-通过FourierFT,和Lora跨越了5个度量. PSO在四个度量标准上进一步超过了业绩最好的LOCA,同时使用37.6%的可训练光谱系数。 一旦选定了坐标,HeuFouFT只需要15-18%的FLOP of Full FT. 这些结果表明,由任务指导的搜索比固定取样更有效地分配有限的光谱容量。 我们的代码是公开的。 2 2 代码见https://github.com/pierrewang2024-collab/HeuFouFT.

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) adapts large language models by learning a small set of parameters while keeping pretrained weights frozen. LoRA represents weight updates through low-rank factors [ 1 ] . Spectral methods offer another parameterization by learning coefficients in a transform domain, where a compact representation can reduce the number of trainable parameters [ 2 , 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 参数高效的微调(PEFT)通过学习一小组参数来适应大型语言模型,同时使预受训练的重量被冻结. LoRA通过低等因素表示重量更新 [一]. 光谱法在变形域中通过学习系数提供另一种参数化,其中紧凑的表示可以减少可训练参数的数量[2,3].

blocks.en: Several approaches exploit spectral structure in adaptation. F-Adapter allocates adapter capacity according to spectral complexity [ 4 ] , while FouRA applies Fourier and cosine transforms within low-rank adaptation for vision models [ 5 ] . LoCA jointly learns coefficients and their locations in a cosine representation [ 6 ] . HeuFouFT differs by selecting a discrete, layer-shared Fourier coordinate set before final fine-tuning through validation-guided derivative-free search.
blocks.zh: 若干方法利用光谱结构进行适应。 F-Adapter根据光谱复杂度分配适配器容量 [4],而FouRA则在低等级可视模型适应性范围内应用Fourier和余弦变换. [5]. LOCA在一个余弦代表中共同学习系数及其位置[6]. HeuFouFT通过验证-导出衍生物无阻搜索,在最终微调前选择一个离散的,分层共享的Fourier坐标集而有所不同.

blocks.en: FourierFT constructs weight updates through an inverse discrete Fourier transform of selected coefficients [ 3 ] . Its default uniform sampling and optional Gaussian band-pass sampling choose coordinates through fixed, task-agnostic rules, so the selected frequency coordinates cannot adapt to the downstream task.
blocks.zh: 傅里叶 FT通过所选系数的逆离散的傅里叶变换来构造重量更新 [3]. 其默认的统一采样和可选的高斯波段-通过采样通过固定的,任务不可知的规则选择坐标,因此所选频率坐标无法适应下游任务.

blocks.en: The choice of coordinates matters when only a small number of Fourier components can be trained. As Figure 1 shows, a learned LoRA update can exhibit localized spectral energy that is poorly covered by uniform or radially constrained sampling. Although this spectrum is not an oracle for FourierFT, it motivates selecting coordinates using downstream task feedback.
blocks.zh: 当只能训练出少量的Fourier组件时,坐标的选择很重要. 如图1所显示,学习的LORA更新可以显示局部光谱能,这种光谱能被统一或受辐射限制的采样覆盖得很差. 虽然这个频谱对于FourierFT来说不是一个神谕,但它激励使用下游任务反馈来选择坐标.

blocks.en: To realize this selection, we draw on derivative-free optimization, which recent efforts [ 7 , 8 ] have applied to low-rank adaptation. Motivated by metaheuristic optimization [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] , we introduce HeuFouFT . Our contributions are threefold. First, we make Fourier coordinate selection responsive to downstream performance rather than a fixed sampling rule. Second, we develop a surrogate-assisted framework that combines a block-level task prior with three metaheuristic optimizers, GA-SA, PSO, and CS, to refine complete coordinate sets. Third, on GPT-2-Medium and E2E, all three variants outperform fixed sampling and LoRA across five metrics while using 37.6% fewer spectral coefficients than the FourierFT and LoCA configurations; PSO further outperforms LoCA on four metrics.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这一选择,我们借鉴了无衍生物优化,最近的努力[7,8]适用于低等级的适应. 以元器件优化[9,10,11]为动机,介绍HeuFouFT. 我们的贡献有三个方面。 首先,我们让傅里叶协调选择适应下游的性能,而不是固定的采样规则. 第二,我们开发一个代用辅助框架,将区块级任务与三个元器件优化器、GA-SA、PSO和CS结合起来,以完善完整的坐标集。 第三,在GPT-2-中度和E2E上,所有三种变体都超过了固定采样和LORA的五个度数,同时使用比FourierFT和LOCA配置更低37.6%的光谱系数;PSO在四个度数上进一步超过了LOCA.

blocks.en: 2 Frequency-Domain Parameterization and Motivation
blocks.zh: 2 频域参数化和动机

blocks.en: For a fixed budget n n , the coordinates in E E determine the Fourier components that can contribute to Δ ​ W \Delta W . Learning c c adjusts their amplitudes within the resulting update subspace. Frequency selection therefore controls the directions for adaptation. Figure 1 reveals that LoRA-derived Δ ​ W \Delta W has its top energy bins concentrated in localized peaks, sharing little overlap with either uniform random sampling or Gaussian band-pass sampling. Fixed schemes cannot align their parameter budget with these irregular regions. Random-uniform FourierFT assigns every coordinate equal selection probability, while Gaussian band-pass sampling constrains selection to an annulus. Our search instead uses lightweight fine-tuning on coarse frequency blocks to initialize the optimizers with task-informed scores.

blocks.en: Spectral evidence alone cannot rank frequency regions by adaptation value. Figure 1 depicts one particular low-rank solution, and Table 1 shows that the preferred Gaussian band-pass setting varies across evaluation metrics. Task feedback is therefore needed to decide where the parameter budget should be placed, and the block-level probes introduced next provide this feedback.

blocks.en: 3 Frequency-Domain Sampling Approaches
blocks.zh: 3 频域取样方法

blocks.en: We first consider two baseline strategies for selecting the frequency coordinates E E . Uniform sampling selects n n points with equal probability, while Gaussian band-pass sampling favors an annulus controlled by frequency bias f c f_{c} and bandwidth W W . Setting f c = 0 f_{c}=0 gives a low-pass region.

blocks.en: 3.1 Heuristic Information Foundation
blocks.zh: 3.1 高血压信息基金会

blocks.en: To guide sampling with task feedback, we partition the frequency domain into a 10 × 10 10\times 10 grid and probe each block through lightweight fine-tuning on 10% of the training data for one epoch, scoring each probe on the validation split. Each probe returns the five NLG metrics, which we normalize and aggregate into a heuristic intensity HI = \displaystyle\mathrm{HI}={} 0.3 ​ BLEU + 0.2 ​ METEOR \displaystyle 0.3\,\mathrm{BLEU}+0.2\,\mathrm{METEOR} (2) + 0.2 ​ ROUGE ​ - ​ L + 0.15 ​ ( NIST + CIDEr ) , \displaystyle+0.2\,\mathrm{ROUGE\text{-}L}+0.15\,(\mathrm{NIST}+\mathrm{CIDEr}), where the normalization removes scale differences among metrics and the coefficients encode relative preferences over them [ 12 ] . For every spectral region, the intensity map scores the downstream performance achievable by placing trainable coefficients there. Notably, the intensity distribution tracks the spectral energy concentration of the low-rank update in Figure 1 , with a Pearson coefficient of r = 0.85 r=0.85 across the 10 × 10 10\times 10 frequency blocks, which supports the reliability of the heuristic map.

blocks.en: Instead of the spectral magnitude of the frozen model, this map measures adaptation value: a spectrally modest region may host coordinates that strongly benefit the task, and vice versa. Because each block score averages over an entire region, however, it cannot indicate which coordinates within a block matter. To resolve this, the metaheuristic searches start from the map, evaluate complete coordinate sets against task performance, and refine the selection below block granularity.
blocks.zh: 与被冻结的模型的光谱相去甚远,本地图衡量了适应值:一个光谱平平的区域可能宿主坐标,对任务非常有利,反之亦然. 但是,由于每个区块的得分平均为整个区域,因此无法说明在区块内哪些坐标。 为了解决这个问题,元器件搜索从地图开始,根据任务性能来评价完整的坐标组,并完善块颗粒度以下的选择.

blocks.en: During search, a Random Forest acts as a filter for each newly generated population. It predicts candidate fitness, and only the top 30% proceed to proxy fine-tuning and validation; the remaining 70% are discarded without training. The surrogate achieves R 2 = 0.86 R^{2}=0.86 on held-out candidates. Its features, labels, and hyperparameters are documented in the released code. 2 2 footnotemark: 2 All task feedback, including block probes, surrogate labels, and search fitness, is computed on the validation split; reported results use the held-out test set.
blocks.zh: 在搜寻过程中,随机森林对每一个新产生的人口起到过滤作用。 它预测候选者是否适合,只有前30%的人进行代理调整和验证;其余的70%未经培训即被抛弃。 替补人选在被搁置候选人上实现R 2 = 0.86 R^{2}=0.86. 它的特征,标签,和超参数被记录在所发布的代码中. 2个脚注: 2 所有任务反馈,包括区块探测器、代用标签和搜索是否合格,均按验证分拆计算;报告的结果使用搁置测试集。

blocks.en: Starting from candidates initialized with the block-level prior, we compare three searches for the layer-shared coordinate set E E under a fixed budget on a d × d d\times d grid ( d = 1024 d=1024 ). Each retained candidate is evaluated by fine-tuning its coefficients on 10% of the training data for one epoch. Its validation HI score from Eq. ( 2 ) serves as the search fitness.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Studies
blocks.zh: 4 实验研究

blocks.en: We evaluate GPT-2-Medium [ 19 ] on E2E [ 20 ] , using 42,000 training examples and 4,600 examples each for validation and testing. Baselines include Full FT, LoRA [ 1 ] , LoCA [ 6 ] , and FourierFT with uniform or Gaussian band-pass sampling [ 3 ] . We report BLEU, NIST, METEOR, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们利用42,000个培训实例和4,600个实例进行验证和测试,在E2E[20]上评价GPT-2-中子[19]。 基线包括Full FT,LORA [1],LOCA [6],以及有制服或高斯带-通过取样的FourierFT[3]. 我们报告BLEU、NIST、METEOR、ROUGE-L和CIDER[21、22、23、24、25]。

blocks.en: All PEFT methods adapt the Q Q and V V projections, following common practice for LoRA [ 1 ] , while Full FT updates the complete model. All methods use AdamW with batch size 4 for three epochs. Learning rates are 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} for FourierFT and LoCA, 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} for LoRA, and 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} for Full FT. LoRA uses rank 8; LoCA uses 1,000 spectral coefficients per adapted matrix; and FourierFT uses α = 16 \alpha=16 . FourierFT and LoCA therefore train 48,000 spectral coefficients across 24 layers and two matrices per layer. HeuFouFT uses 624 selected coordinates and 624 independently trainable real coefficients per matrix, giving 24 × 2 × 624 = 29,952 24\times 2\times 624=29{,}952 parameters (0.030M), 37.6% fewer than those configurations. The selected E E is fixed across three seeds, so the standard deviations reflect fine-tuning stochasticity rather than search variance.

blocks.en: 4.2 Overall Performance

blocks.en: PSO achieves the highest BLEU, NIST, METEOR, and CIDEr, while CS yields the highest ROUGE-L. All three HeuFouFT variants outperform the fixed sampling baselines and LoRA. They do so with 37.6% fewer coefficients than the FourierFT configurations, showing that task feedback can allocate a smaller spectral budget more effectively than a random-uniform draw or a radial band. Adding simulated annealing to Vanilla GA improves all five metrics. The consistent gain supports its role in escaping local optima that greedy evolution can settle into.

blocks.en: The three optimizers use the common intensity prior in different ways. PSO repeatedly moves candidates toward personal and swarm bests, so its coordinates cluster around a compact middle-frequency region favored by the prior. CS makes occasional long jumps through Lévy flights and replaces weaker nests, producing broader exploration and more high-frequency coordinates. GA-SA combines crossover and mutation with annealed acceptance of temporary fitness decreases; it therefore preserves a more balanced middle-to-high-frequency distribution and is less likely to collapse around one region. Their similar downstream performance indicates that the task-guided framework supplies the main gain, while the optimizer controls how the region rich in frequency-domain information is explored.

GA-SA splits nearly all coordinates between the middle and high bands and scores lower on the aggregate quality measure, reflecting its more diffuse search. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented HeuFouFT, a task-guided framework that selects Fourier coordinates using block-level probes, Random Forest filtering, and metaheuristic search. On GPT-2-Medium and E2E, all three variants outperform fixed sampling and LoRA across five metrics while using 37.6% fewer coefficients than the FourierFT and LoCA configurations; PSO further outperforms LoCA on four metrics. Once coordinates are selected, HeuFouFT requires only 15–18% FLOPs of Full FT. Moreover, the three searches reach similar performance from distinct frequency distributions, so the benefit stems from task-guided selection itself rather than the optimizer. These results demonstrate that task-guided coordinate search can allocate limited spectral adaptation capacity effectively.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了HeuFouFT, 一个任务指导框架, 它选择傅里叶坐标 使用区块级探测器,随机森林过滤, 和元器件搜索。 在GPT-2-中度和E2E上,所有三种变体都比固定取样和LORA超过5个度数,而使用系数比FourierFT和LOCA配置少37.6%;PSO在4个度数上进一步超过LOCA. 一旦选定坐标,HeuFouFT只需要15–18%的FLOP全FT. 此外,三次搜索从不同的频率分布中达到了相近的性能,因此好处来自于任务引导选择本身而不是优化器. 这些结果表明,由任务指导的坐标搜索能够有效分配有限的光谱适应能力。

By calculating the proportion of energy covered by the frequency points selected through sampling, this indicator directly reflects the accuracy of the sampling strategy: a higher EC value indicates that the sampling points are more capable of focusing on core energy components, resulting in less redundant computation and higher fine-tuning efficiency.

Its core principle is to measure the proportion of matching n-grams between candidate and reference texts, with higher overlap indicating better quality. blocks.en: C.1 Motivation and Design Rationale

blocks.en: The Random Forest (RF) surrogate model in HeuFouFT is designed to filter low-potential frequency candidates prior to meta-heuristic optimization (GA-SA, PSO, CS), reducing redundant computations while preserving high-performance sampling points. Its core design aligns with HeuFouFT’s heuristic sampling philosophy: prioritize frequency components that contribute most to fine-tuning performance by leveraging multi-dimensional spectral features. The model is trained to map spectral characteristics of frequency candidates to their actual fine-tuning performance (e.g., BLEU score), enabling rapid screening of high-value candidates.
blocks.zh: HeuFouFT中的随机森林(RF)替代模型旨在在元热优化(GA-SA,PSO,CS)前筛选出低潜在频率候选者,在保留高性能采样点的同时减少冗余计算. 其核心设计符合HeuFouFT的热采样哲学:通过利用多维光谱特征,优先排序最能促进微调性能的频率组件. 该模型经过了培训,能够将频率考生的光谱特征映射到他们的实际微调性能上(例如BLEU分数),从而能够快速筛选出高值考生.

blocks.en: Regarding the meta-heuristic searches, the GA-SA hybrid algorithm uses a population size of 100, 175 total iterations, a mutation probability of 0.05, initial temperature of 1000, and decay rate of 0.95, with per-iteration operations including two-point crossover, bit-flip mutation, and Metropolis acceptance criterion; each iteration takes 60 seconds, leading to a total wall-clock time of 175 × 60 ​ s = 175 ​ minutes 175\times 60\ \text{s}=175\ \text{minutes} ( 2.92 hours) and total FLOPs of 6.3 × 10 16 6.3\times 10^{16} (with 3.6 × 10 14 3.6\times 10^{14} FLOPs per iteration).
blocks.zh: 关于元heuristic搜索,GA-SA混合算法采用人口大小为100,175总迭代,变相概率为0.05,初温为1000,衰变速率为0.95,每个迭代操作包括双点交叉,比特快突变,和大都会接受标准;每次迭代需要60秒,导致总时长175×60秒=175分175分175分175分175分60\text{s\175\text{minutes}(2.92小时)和FLOPs 6.3×10 16 6.3\tims 10^{16}(每迭代3.6×10 14 3.6×tims 10^{14) FLOPs.

blocks.en: The Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm employs 50 particles, 240 total iterations, a linearly decreasing inertia weight (from 0.9 to 0.4), and acceleration constants c 1 = c 2 = 1.4945 c_{1}=c_{2}=1.4945 , with per-iteration operations including velocity update, sigmoid-based position adjustment, and boundary constraint enforcement via modulo arithmetic; each iteration takes 45 seconds, resulting in a total wall-clock time of 240 × 45 ​ s = 180 ​ minutes 240\times 45\ \text{s}=180\ \text{minutes} (3 hours) and total FLOPs of 6.72 × 10 16 6.72\times 10^{16} (with 2.8 × 10 14 2.8\times 10^{14} FLOPs per iteration).
blocks.zh: 颗粒优化(PSO)算法使用50个粒子,240个总重迭起,线性递减惯性重(从0.9到0.4),加速度常数c 1 = c 2 = 1.4945 c_{ 1}=c_{2}= 1.4945 ,每一次穿入操作包括速度更新,以西格莫德为基础的位置调整,通过modulo算术执行边界约束;每次迭起需要45秒,导致总壁时长为240×45 s =180分240\tess 45\text{s}=180\text{mins}(3小时)和总FLOP为6.72×10 16.72\times 10^{16}(有 2.8×10 14 2.8\tims 10^{14}FLOPs peration).

blocks.en: The Cuckoo Search (CS) with Lévy Flights uses 20 nests, 151 total iterations, a Lévy flight parameter λ = 1.5 \lambda=1.5 , a cosine-decayed step size α \alpha (from 0.5 to 0.1), and a nest elimination probability of 0.25, with per-iteration operations including Lévy flight perturbation, nest selection, and duplicate point removal; each iteration takes 30 seconds, leading to a total wall-clock time of 151 × 30 ​ s = 75.5 ​ minutes 151\times 30\ \text{s}=75.5\ \text{minutes} ( 1.26 hours) and total FLOPs of 2.87 × 10 16 2.87\times 10^{16} (with 1.9 × 10 14 1.9\times 10^{14} FLOPs per iteration).
blocks.zh: Cuckoo搜索(CS)与Lévy Flights使用20个巢穴,151个总迭接,一个Lévy飞行参数 = 1.5\lambda= 1.5,一个同位素去除后步大小 α\α (从0.5到0.1),并有0.25个巢消除概率,每次迭接操作包括Lévy飞行扰动,巢选择,并重复取出点;每次迭接地需要30秒,导致壁时总时间为151×30 s =75.5分 151\text{s} (1.26小时)和FLOP总时间为 2.87×10 2.87\ 16.87\tex 10^{16}(每次迭接1.9×10 1.9\x14 10^{14) FLOPs.

blocks.en: The FLOP and memory reduction metrics reported in the main text are end-to-end, encompassing all steps of HeuFouFT: heuristic intensity map construction, surrogate model labeling and training, meta-heuristic sampling search, and final fine-tuning of the LLM, ensuring a comprehensive comparison with baselines (e.g., LoRA, vanilla FourierFT) that only include final training. For FLOPs calculation, we track floating-point operations via torch.cuda.flops_counter() across all computational graphs (forward/backward passes for fine-tuning, sampling scheme generation, surrogate model training), with FP16 precision consistently applied to align with GPU hardware capabilities and reduce redundant computations. Peak GPU memory usage is recorded via torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() , including model weights (LLM + surrogate), intermediate activations, sampling scheme storage, and gradient buffers, with cache management (e.g., clearing unused tensors post-iteration) applied to mimic real-world deployment. Wall-clock time is measured via time.perf_counter() , with data loading time excluded (preprocessed E2E data is cached in GPU memory to eliminate I/O overhead), and each step is repeated 3 times to report the average time accounting for minor runtime fluctuations.
blocks.zh: 主文中报告的FLOP和内存还原度量度是端到端的,包括了HeuFouFT的所有步骤:热力强度图构造,代用模型标签和培训,元热采样搜索,以及LLM的最终微调,确保了与基准(如:LORA,vanilla FourierFT)的全面比较,只包括了最后的培训. 对于FLOPs的计算,我们通过火炬.cuda.flops_counter()跟踪所有计算图的浮点操作(向后/向后通过微调,采样方案生成,代用模型训练),FP16精度一致应用来配合GPU硬件能力并减少冗余计算. 峰值GPU内存使用通过火炬.cuda.max_memory_aldicent ()来记录,包括模型权重(LLM + 代用),中间活化,采样方案存储,和梯度缓冲,缓存管理(如清除未使用的穿入后百分位数)应用来模仿现实世界的部署. Wall-Chourl时间通过time.perf_counter ()来测量,不包括数据加载时间(预处理的E2E数据被缓存到GPU内存中去去去去去I/O的间接费用),每个步骤重复三次来报告平均时间核算小运行时间波动.
